youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的認識鄰居情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從圍欄邊第一次打招呼、自我介紹住了幾年、聊天氣與四季、遛狗時停下聊天、借梯子與工具、說清垃圾日與停車規矩，到受邀參加社區烤肉、道別互留電話，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Meeting the Neighbours phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — a first hello at the garden fence, years lived in the same house, weather and four seasons, a dog-walk chat, borrowing a ladder and tools, trash day and parking rules, a backyard barbecue invitation, and exchanging phone numbers. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi there, I am Sam from next door.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðɪr, aɪ æm sæm frʌm nɛkst dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, hello! I am Lucy, the new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, hɛˈloʊ! aɪ æm ˈlusi, ðə nu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 喔，你好！我是露西，新搬來的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Welcome to Maple Street, Lucy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you! We just moved in today.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju! wi dʒʌst muvd ɪn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！我今天才剛搬進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw the big truck this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ðə bɪɡ trʌk ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我今早看到那輛大貨車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it took three trips to empty it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt tʊk θri trɪps tu ˈɛmti ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，跑了三趟才把車清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three trips is a lot of boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri trɪps ɪz ə lɑt əv ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 跑三趟代表有很多紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My room is still full of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rum ɪz stɪl fʊl əv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 我房間裡還四處是箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Need help with all those boxes?
dialogue.zh: 那些箱子，需要我搭把手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is kind, my brother helped.
dialogue.zh: 你真貼心，我哥剛幫過忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, a brother is the best help.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd, ə ˈbrʌðər ɪz ðə bɛst hɛlp./
dialogue.zh: 那就好，兄弟幫忙最省事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He left already, so I am alone here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi lɛft ɔlˈrɛdi, soʊ aɪ æm əˈloʊn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 他已經回去了，所以我在這兒一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is your family, if I may ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz jɔr ˈfæməli, ɪf aɪ meɪ æsk?/
dialogue.zh: 方便問一下，你的家人呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just me and my dog, Milo.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dog! I love dogs a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɔɡ! aɪ lʌv dɔɡz ə lɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is shy with new people, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz ʃaɪ wɪð nu ˈpipəl, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 但他見到陌生人會害羞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he at home right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he is inside with my boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hi ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd wɪð maɪ ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 在，他在屋裡陪著那些箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, your fence door is wide open.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, jɔr fɛns dɔr ɪz waɪd ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 對了，你圍欄的門大開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no! He can run out to the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ! hi kæn rʌn aʊt tu ðə roʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will close it for you, no worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kloʊz ɪt fər ju, noʊ ˈwɜri./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, he cannot run now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, is this your first day here?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, ɪz ðɪs jɔr fɜrst deɪ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 所以，這是你在這兒的第一天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First day, and I already feel lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst deɪ, ænd aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi fil lɔst./
dialogue.zh: 才第一天，我就已經覺得迷路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strange is normal on a new street.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪndʒ ɪz ˈnɔrməl ɑn ə nu strit./
dialogue.zh: 在陌生的街上，覺得怪很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep counting the houses by color.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip ˈkaʊntɪŋ ðə ˈhaʊzɪz baɪ ˈkʌlər./
dialogue.zh: 我都靠著顏色去認每一戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your house is the small blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr haʊs ɪz ðə smɔl blu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 你家是那棟藍色的小房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your yellow one has a big porch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd jɔr ˈjɛloʊ wʌn hæz ə bɪɡ pɔrtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 你那棟黃色的則有個大陽台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best place in summer, I promise you.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst pleɪs ɪn ˈsʌmər, aɪ ˈprɑmɪs ju./
dialogue.zh: 那兒夏天最舒服，我跟你保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I need a place for plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, aɪ nid ə pleɪs fər plænts./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我正想找個地方種花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will love the light back there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl lʌv ðə laɪt bæk ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 後院那片光線你會很愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sun hits my kitchen all morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn hɪts maɪ ˈkɪtʃən ɔl ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 太陽整個上午都照進我的廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you work, or are you resting?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɜrk, ɔr ɑr ju ˈrɛstɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 妳有工作嗎，還是先休息？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I work at a flower shop downtown.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɜrk æt ə ˈflaʊər ʃɑp ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我在城裡一家花店上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A flower shop! That is a fun job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈflaʊər ʃɑp! ðæt ɪz ə fʌn dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 花店啊！那是個有趣的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like it, mostly with people.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡，尤其是跟人聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains the friendly look, then.
dialogue.zh: 難怪你看起來這麼親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that a good sign, here?
dialogue.zh: 在這條街上算是好事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A good thing on this street.
dialogue.zh: 在這條街上絕對是好事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody here seems to hurry, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過這裡看起來沒人趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the street is slow in mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðə strit ɪz sloʊ ɪn ˈmɔrnɪŋz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like slow. My old street was loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk sloʊ. maɪ oʊld striːt wʌz laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡慢，我以前的那條街很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where was your old place?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A busy street near the train station.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbɪzi strit nɪr ðə treɪn ˈsteɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 火車站旁邊一條很忙的街。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds loud every single night.
dialogue.zh: 那聽起來每晚都吵得要命。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cars, horns, and one very loud dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrz, hɔrnz, ənd wʌn ˈvɛri laʊd dɔɡ./
dialogue.zh: 車子、喇叭，還有一隻很大聲的狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thing you found us, neighbor.
dialogue.zh: 幸好你來到我們這條街。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope I stay here a long time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp aɪ steɪ hɪr ə lɔŋ taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found anything hard so far?
dialogue.zh: 到目前為止，有什麼難處嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The trash day, mostly, and the parking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə træʃ deɪ, ˈmoʊstli, ənd ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 主要是倒垃圾的日子，還有停車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both of those confuse new people.
dialogue.zh: 那兩樣，新住戶都會搞混。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Please, do not let me guess.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! pliz, du nɑt lɛt mi ɡɛs./
dialogue.zh: 對，拜託直接說，別讓我亂猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will tell you both, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tɛl ju boʊθ, noʊ rʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 兩件事我都會跟你說，不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are too nice, neighbor Sam.
dialogue.zh: 你人也太好了，鄰居山姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the water in your kitchen?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɪz ðə ˈwɔtər ɪn jɔr ˈkɪtʃən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold is fine, but hot takes time.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ɪz faɪn, bʌt hɑt teɪks taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 冷水沒問題，熱水要等很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The heater is old, mine makes noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhitər ɪz oʊld, maɪn meɪks nɔɪz./
dialogue.zh: 暖爐是老舊的，我那臺也會吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine clicks all night long, too.
dialogue.zh: 我家那臺整夜喀喀作響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call a man for that, it is cheap.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ə mæn fər ðæt, ɪt ɪz tʃip./
dialogue.zh: 這個要請師傅來弄，費用不貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you know a good one here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju noʊ ə ɡʊd wʌn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你在這兒認識不錯的師傅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife's cousin fixes these things.
dialogue.zh: 我太太的表哥專修這玩意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please tell him I need help.
dialogue.zh: 請幫我跟他說我需要幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure. Is your box still on the path?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr. ɪz jɔr bɑks stɪl ɑn ðə pæθ?/
dialogue.zh: 當然。你的箱子還放在走道上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the heavy one by the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈhɛvi wʌn baɪ ðə ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 在，就是大門口那箱重的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one looks heavy for one person.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn lʊks ˈhɛvi fər wʌn ˈpɜrsən./
dialogue.zh: 那一箱給一個人搬太重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is only books and old cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli bʊks ənd oʊld kʌps./
dialogue.zh: 裡面只有書和一些舊杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can carry it up your steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ˈkæri ɪt ʌp jɔr stɛps./
dialogue.zh: 我可以幫你搬上你家階梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you sure? That is very kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ʃʊr? ðæt ɪz ˈvɛri kaɪnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do this for new neighbors, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ðɪs fər nu ˈneɪbərz, ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我對新鄰居一向都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will do it for others.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl du ɪt fər ˈʌðərz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put this one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left side, near the tall window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. What is inside this one now?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn. wʌt ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs wʌn naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 放好了。這箱裝的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My winter coats and one big pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwɪntər koʊts ənd wʌn bɪɡ pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我的冬外套還有一個大鍋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Winter is far away, you know.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust me, this place gets cold fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst mi, ðɪs pleɪs ɡɛts koʊld fæst./
dialogue.zh: 相信我，這裡一下子就冷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will want thick blankets then.
dialogue.zh: 到時候你要準備厚毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do people buy those around here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ˈpipəl baɪ ðoz əˈraʊnd hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 大家在附近哪裡買那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The store on Third Street has them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɔr ɑn θɜrd strit hæz ðɛm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You mean the one by the park?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju min ðə wʌn baɪ ðə pɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 你是說公園旁邊那一家？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and their coffee is cheap.
dialogue.zh: 對，他們賣的咖啡也便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. I need a coffee place.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我正需要一間咖啡店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any questions for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz fər mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One. Who can I ask about the yard?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn. hu kæn aɪ æsk əˈbaʊt ðə jɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 有一個。草皮的事該問誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Me. My tools are in the garage.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi. maɪ tuːlz ɑr ɪn ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ./
dialogue.zh: 問我。我的工具放在車庫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The garage with the blue door?
dialogue.zh: 是藍色的門那間車庫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one. Knock any time before eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn. nɑk ˈɛni taɪm bɪˈfɔr eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就那間，八點前都可以敲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight at night? That is late.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight in the evening, my wife sleeps early.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ɪn ði ˈivnɪŋ, maɪ waɪf slips ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 是晚上八點，我太太睡得早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood. Before eight, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You look tired, big day tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 你看起來很累，明天有事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my shop opens at seven again.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, maɪ ʃɑp ˈoʊpənz æt ˈsɛvən əˈɡɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go rest, I will see you around.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ rɛst, aɪ wɪl si ju əˈraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 去休息吧，我們還會常見面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sam. Good night to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju, sæm. ɡʊd naɪt tu ju./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，山姆，也祝你晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well. My porch light stays on.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl. maɪ pɔrtʃ laɪt steɪz ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 好好睡，我陽台那盞燈會亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That makes me feel better already.
dialogue.zh: 這樣說我已經安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my card, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz maɪ kɑrd, dʒʌst ɪn keɪs./
dialogue.zh: 這是我的卡片，留著備用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep this, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you across the fence soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon. Good night, neighbor Sam.
dialogue.zh: 很快再見，晚安鄰居山姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning, Lucy! Back from work?
dialogue.zh: 早安，露西！下班回來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just back. The shop was busy.
dialogue.zh: 才剛回來，店裡客人多得不得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Busy is good for flowers, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪzi ɪz ɡʊd fər ˈflaʊərz, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想忙碌對花店是好事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True. People buy on Fridays.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，星期五大家都買花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What exactly do you do there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I arrange, wrap, and check people out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ əˈreɪndʒ, ræp, ænd tʃɛk ˈpipəl aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 我插花、包花，也負責收銀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A job with your hands, that is nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dʒɑb wɪð jɔr hændz, ðæt ɪz naɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like it more every year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you move much before this?
dialogue.zh: 來這裡之前，你常搬家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three times, actually. This one stays.
dialogue.zh: 其實三次。這次我定下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long did you live in the last one?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dɪd ju lɪv ɪn ðə læst wʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two years. The rent went up fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu jɪrz. ðə rɛnt wɛnt ʌp fæst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rent here is fair, people say.
dialogue.zh: 大家都說，這裡的租金公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was the reason I said yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz ðə ˈrizən aɪ sɛd jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 這正是我答應租的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This yard keeps me busy, no lie.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs jɑrd kips mi ˈbɪzi, noʊ laɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這個院子讓我忙不停，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long have you two lived here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju tu lɪvd hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你們兩個住這裡多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last April, twelve years, Kate and I.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst ˈeɪprəl, twɛlv jɪrz, keɪt ænd aɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今年四月就滿十二年了，凱特和我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve! That is a real home now.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv! ðæt ɪz ə ril hoʊm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 十二年！那已經是真正的家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We bought it empty, just walls.
dialogue.zh: 我們買的時候是空的，只有牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty walls! Where did the money go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmti wɔlz! wɛr dɪd ðə ˈmʌni ɡoʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Into the roof, twice. Trust me.
dialogue.zh: 全花在屋頂上，還是兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A roof is not cheap, I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ruf ɪz nɑt tʃip, aɪ si./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The maple was a small stick then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmeɪpəl wʌz ə smɔl stɪk ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那棵楓樹當時只是根小樹苗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stick? Now it shades your whole porch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stɪk? naʊ ɪt ʃeɪdz jɔr hoʊl pɔrtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 樹苗？現在它遮住了整個陽台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son planted it, he was six.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn ˈplæntɪd ɪt, hi wʌz sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 我兒子種的，他當時六歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where is your son now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the city, he fixes computers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A computer man. My sister needs one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kəmˈpjutər mæn. maɪ ˈsɪstər nidz wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 修電腦的人，我姊正需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have family close by?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My sister lives two towns away.
dialogue.zh: 我姊住在兩個小鎮之外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two towns is not far at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu taʊnz ɪz nɑt fɑr ət ɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She visits on Sundays, with noise.
dialogue.zh: 她每週日都來，還帶一堆吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noise is good in an empty house.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɔɪz ɪz ɡʊd ɪn æn ˈɛmpti haʊs./
dialogue.zh: 空房子裡有點吵反而好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My parents live far, in the south.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpɛrənts lɪv fɑr, ɪn ðə saʊθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you talk to them every week?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju tɔk tu ðɛm ˈɛvəri wik?/
dialogue.zh: 你每週都跟他們說話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every Sunday night, on the phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a good habit, Lucy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mom says the same to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ mɑm sɛz ðə seɪm tu mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kate will ask about you tonight.
dialogue.zh: 凱特今晚一定會問起你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! Your wife knows about me already?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ! jɔr waɪf noʊz əˈbaʊt mi ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 噢！你太太已經知道我了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She saw the truck, and the boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɔ ðə trʌk, ənd ðə ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 她看到那輛車和那些箱子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She was there the whole day?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, she only heard me talk.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，她只是聽我在說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You talk loud by that fence.
dialogue.zh: 你在那道圍欄邊說話很大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guilty. Kate works at the clinic.
dialogue.zh: 我認了。凱特在診所上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A clinic? I need a new doctor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈklɪnɪk? aɪ nid ə nu ˈdɑktər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She books them, she is not a doctor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi bʊks ðɛm, ʃi ɪz nɑt ə ˈdɑktər./
dialogue.zh: 她負責掛號，她又不是醫師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is she good with tired people?
dialogue.zh: 她對累壞的人有耐心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very. Her tea helps everyone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will visit on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our daughter lives two streets off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two streets! Is she friendly too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is, she teaches art nearby.
dialogue.zh: 她人很好，在附近教美術。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An art teacher! My nephew needs that.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ɑrt ˈtitʃər! maɪ ˈnɛfju nidz ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 美術老師！我外甥正需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he draw, your nephew?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only on his tablet, all day.
dialogue.zh: 只在平板上畫，一畫一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tablets, hm. My son was the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtæbləts, hʌm. maɪ sʌn wʌz ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 平板啊，我兒子以前也這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boys and screens, a long story.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me yours. Why this street?
dialogue.zh: 換說你的，為什麼選這條街？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A photo online, and the price.
dialogue.zh: 網路上的照片，還有價位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A photo brought you here?
dialogue.zh: 一張照片就把你帶來了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The garden, mostly. Look at it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡɑrdən, ˈmoʊstli. lʊk æt ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 主要是那個院子，你瞧瞧現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine? I cut it, nothing more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks calm. That matters.
dialogue.zh: 看起來很安靜，這很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You rent, or you bought it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I rent. The owner lives out west.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rɛnt. ði ˈoʊnər lɪvz aʊt wɛst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out west. Is he a nice guy?
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt wɛst. ɪz hi ə naɪs ɡaɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Polite, but slow with repairs.
dialogue.zh: 很有禮貌，只是修東西很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then call my cousin, seriously.
dialogue.zh: 那就找我表哥，我是認真說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will. He is cheaper, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheaper, and he never loses tools.
dialogue.zh: 便宜，而且工具從不弄丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tidy man? That is rare.
dialogue.zh: 愛整齊的人？那可真少見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the rest of the street.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Tell me who lives where.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The Lees are across, by the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə liz ɑr əˈkrɔs, baɪ ðə ˈkɔrnər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old Mr. Lee, with the birds?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Him. Six cages, all morning song.
dialogue.zh: 就是他，六個籠子叫一早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six! Do they wake you up?
dialogue.zh: 六個！牠們會不會吵醒你？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not now, I am used to it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt naʊ, aɪ æm juzd tu ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The Patels, next door to me?
dialogue.zh: 帕泰爾家就在我隔壁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three kids, and one loud truck.
dialogue.zh: 三個孩子，還有一輛吵貨車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red truck! It wakes the dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd trʌk! ɪt weɪks ðə dɔɡ./
dialogue.zh: 那輛紅貨車！米洛會被吵醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Poor Milo. They know, I think.
dialogue.zh: 可憐的米洛，我想他們知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids and dogs are always loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Little Nina waves at everyone.
dialogue.zh: 小尼娜對每個人都揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The girl on the green bike?
dialogue.zh: 是騎綠單車那個女孩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is her, brave little thing.
dialogue.zh: 就是她，人小小卻很膽大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like that kid already.
dialogue.zh: 我已經喜歡這個小孩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mrs. Park, the quiet one, grows roses.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsəz pɑrk, ði ˈkwaɪət wʌn, groʊz ˈroʊzɪz./
dialogue.zh: 朴太太很安靜，她在家種薔薇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her roses are huge every June.
dialogue.zh: 她薔薇每年六月都開得好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not touch them, she will know.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt tʌtʃ ðɛm, ʃi wɪl noʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted! What about Dana, the mail carrier?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd! wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈdeɪnə, ðə meɪl ˈkɛriər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She waves, you wave. That is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi weɪvz, ju weɪv. ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 她揮手，你也揮手，就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy. I can do that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more, Mr. Ito at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr, ˈmɪstər ˈitoʊ æt ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 還有一位，巷尾的伊藤先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The house with the red door?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Him. He keeps the street list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A list of names? For what?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For the street dinner, in August.
dialogue.zh: 為了八月那場街上聚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring something sweet, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot again, huh?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My kitchen is a sauna now.
dialogue.zh: 我的廚房現在像個烤箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sauna with no door, right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly! I open every window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine face the west, bad choice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back ones are fine, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close the big one at two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At two? Before it gets hot?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When it is hottest, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will try that today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a fan inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small one, from my brother.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small fan is not enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know. I sleep on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ. aɪ slip ɑn ðə flɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor? Clever, cool air stays low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr? ˈklɛvər, kul ɛr steɪz loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 睡地上？聰明，涼空氣往下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother did that years ago.
dialogue.zh: 我媽很多年前就這樣睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parents know the cheap tricks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about the shade outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your side has no tree at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr saɪd hæz noʊ tri ət ɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I need something tall, soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bamboo grows fast, and costs little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bamboo! My shop sells that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course it does, silly me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring two home tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two plants, one for each side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water them twice a day, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In heat, yes, but not at noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn hit, jɛs, bʌt nɑt æt nun./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noon water burns the leaves?
dialogue.zh: 中午澆水會燙傷葉子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, that one is an old myth.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðæt wʌn ɪz ən oʊld mɪθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, my plants would be angry.
dialogue.zh: 還好，不然我的植物要生氣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any rain in your plan today?
dialogue.zh: 你今天有安排雨天備案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The radio says thunder at nine.
dialogue.zh: 收音機說九點有雷陣雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine! Then hang no clothes out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside? My rack is full already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside is fine, it dries slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow is fine. I have time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear last night's thunder?
dialogue.zh: 你聽見昨晚的雷聲了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I counted four big booms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our whole block lost power.
dialogue.zh: 我們這一整排都停電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too! For ten long minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes felt like a week.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sat with Milo in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sæt wɪð ˈmaɪloʊ ɪn ðə dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 我抱著米洛坐在黑暗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. Do you keep a flashlight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I do, in my coat pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ du, ɪn maɪ koʊt ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 現在有了，放在外套口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also candles, but be careful.
dialogue.zh: 也可以點蠟燭，但要小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have two, from a birthday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last week's storm broke a branch.
dialogue.zh: 上週狂風吹斷一根樹枝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the street? That big maple?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, on Mr. Lee's fence.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. Did he see it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He called me, we cut it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kɔld mi, wi kʌt ɪt ʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is firewood for winter!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He gave me two pieces, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do you burn wood inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not inside, the fire pit out back.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɪnˈsaɪd, ðə ˈfaɪər pɪt aʊt bæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have a fire pit? Wonderful!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Autumn nights, that is the place.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love autumn. Leaves, sweaters.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweaters already? It is August.
dialogue.zh: 就毛衣了？現在是八月耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In my head it is October.
dialogue.zh: 在我心裡已經是十月了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: October here turns the whole street.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的十月會染整條街。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red, gold, orange, all at once.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The maples, mostly, then the oaks.
dialogue.zh: 主要是楓樹，再來是橡樹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oaks drop late, into November.
dialogue.zh: 橡樹落葉晚，落到十一月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And we rake, all weekend long.
dialogue.zh: 我們整個週末都在耙葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many bags does that take?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight bags last year, no joke.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight! Do they pick those up?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, leaf day is in the fall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, lif deɪ ɪz ɪn ðə fɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than my old balcony.
dialogue.zh: 比我以前那個陽台好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You had no yard before this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just two pots and a cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, dʒʌst tu pɑts ənd ə kæt./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，只有兩盆花和一隻貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cat? Do you still have him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kæt? du ju stɪl hæv hɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he died, his name was Ping.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, hi daɪd, hɪz neɪm wʌz pɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 不了，他走了，名字叫阿平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry about that, hard thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was years ago. Milo helps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He looks like a good listener.
dialogue.zh: 他看起來很會聽人說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best, and he never talks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fall here is short, then snow comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔl hɪr ɪz ʃɔrt, ðɛn snoʊ kʌmz./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的秋天很短，接著就下雪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet! The coat is still boxed.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt! ðə koʊt ɪz stɪl bɑkst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boxed! Then let us talk snow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it really snow that much?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two big storms, most winters here.
dialogue.zh: 多數冬天會來兩場大雪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who clears this long street then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We each shovel our own side.
dialogue.zh: 各家自己鏟自己那半邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I start at my fence line?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ stɑrt æt maɪ fɛns laɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and up to the mailbox.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That slope turns to pure ice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salt it, or you will slide.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, when the cold comes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My garage has a big salt bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɡəˈrɑʒ hæz ə bɪɡ sɔlt bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And tools for the snow, I guess.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd tuːlz fər ðə snoʊ, aɪ ɡɛs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shovels, yes, and a pair of warm gloves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɑvəlz, jɛs, ænd ə pɛr əv wɔrm ɡlʌvz./
dialogue.zh: 鏟子有，還有一副保暖手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gloves! I lost mine last January.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold hands make a cold winter.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True. What about the pipes, though?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let one drip on cold nights.
dialogue.zh: 寒冷的晚上讓水滴滴流。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A drip stops a freeze, clever.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You talk like a real neighbor now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tɔk laɪk ə ril ˈneɪbər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你說話已經像個老鄰居了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon I will know all four seasons.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun aɪ wɪl noʊ ɔl fɔr ˈsizənz./
dialogue.zh: 再不久，四季我就都認得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Evening! Is that the famous Milo?
dialogue.zh: 傍晚啦！那是出名的米洛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is no trouble, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 他一點都不惹事，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come here, boy! Say hello.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, he jumps on tall men.
dialogue.zh: 小心，他會往高個子身上撲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tall? I am average, look.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry! He is shy, not rude.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！他是害羞，不是沒禮貌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is fine. May I pet him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz faɪn. meɪ aɪ pɛt hɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but slow, from the side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: From the side, got it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, he likes a calm hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft fur. What breed is he?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No one knows. Some terrier, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 沒人知道，大概是梗犬吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A terrier! That explains the ears.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the digging, three holes yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 還有挖洞，昨天挖了三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three holes? In whose yard?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine, sadly. He found a worm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worms are serious work, I know.
dialogue.zh: 抓蟲可是正經事，我知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell that to my ruined shoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he chew things inside, too?
dialogue.zh: 他在家裡也亂咬東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One slipper a week, like clockwork.
dialogue.zh: 一週一隻拖鞋，準時得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A week! He has a schedule.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I buy cheap slippers on purpose.
dialogue.zh: 我故意只買便宜的拖鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you get him, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the shelter past the bakery.
dialogue.zh: 在麵包店再過去的收容所。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know the place, small signs.
dialogue.zh: 我知道那地方，招牌很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three dogs in one small room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He chose you, I bet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He sat right on my feet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then he had to come home.
dialogue.zh: 那他就非跟你回家不可了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ride was loud and short.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he cry in the new place?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd hi kraɪ ɪn ðə nu pleɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two nights, then he stole my pillow.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu naɪts, ðɛn hi stoʊl maɪ ˈpɪloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 鬧了兩晚，然後偷我的枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleeping on your pillow, a boss.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He thinks he owns the whole house.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi θɪŋks hi oʊnz ði hoʊl haʊs./
dialogue.zh: 他以為這棟房子是他的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free rent, clever dog.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He pays with walks, all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far do you two walk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One loop of the park, twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The park is ten good minutes.
dialogue.zh: 公園走一圈要足足十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With stops, thirty. He sniffs everything.
dialogue.zh: 一路停就是三十分鐘，他什麼都要聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sniffing is how they read news.
dialogue.zh: 聞東西就是他們讀新聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you know dogs, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I had one, a big brown dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæd wʌn, ə bɪɡ braʊn dɔɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我養過一隻，大隻棕色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What was his name?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boss. A silly name, I know.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big dog, big name, correct.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirteen years at home with us.
dialogue.zh: 他跟我們在家住了十三年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a long, good life.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is. He is gone now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, Sam. I am sorry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two years this month. Still quiet.
dialogue.zh: 這個月滿兩年，家裡還是很靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The house misses a dog.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kate says not yet, one more year.
dialogue.phonetic: /keɪt sɛz nɑt jɛt, wʌn mɔr jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 凱特說還不到時候，再等一年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waiting a year is kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son asks about Boss still.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did you do with his bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ju du wɪð hɪz bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 他那張狗床你們怎麼處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sits by the back door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should let Milo try it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would he? It smells like Boss.
dialogue.zh: 他會嗎？那上面有波士的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dogs do not mind old smells.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe, then. It feels strange.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strange is all right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are good at that, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ɡʊd æt ðæt, ju noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你很會說這種話，你知道嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At what? Saying strange things?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At making a man feel less old.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə mæn fil lɛs oʊld./
dialogue.zh: 會讓一個男人覺得自己不老。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are not old, Sam.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could walk with you two, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kʊd wɔk wɪð ju tu, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過，我可以陪你們倆走走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You want to come with us?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only to the corner, my knees.
dialogue.zh: 只走到轉角就好，我膝蓋不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your knees? Mine hurt from boxes.
dialogue.zh: 你膝蓋？我被那些箱子壓到全身都痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Carrying all day does that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I slept nine hours, all out.
dialogue.zh: 我睡了九小時，整個癱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine! You look rested, then.
dialogue.zh: 九小時！那你看起來睡飽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do. But the harness is muddy.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du. bʌt ðə ˈhɑrnɪs ɪz ˈmʌdi./
dialogue.zh: 是睡飽了，可胸背帶髒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wash it, he smells like a pond.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ ɪt, hi smɛlz laɪk ə pɑnd./
dialogue.zh: 洗洗吧，牠聞起來像水塘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A pond! He found the creek again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pɑnd! hi faʊnd ðə krik əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 水塘！他又去弄那個水溝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The creek path is closed, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə krik pæθ ɪz kloʊzd, ju noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 水溝那條步道是關的呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed? Then why does everyone use it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd? ðɛn waɪ dʌz ˈɛvriˌwʌn juz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 關起來了？那為什麼大家還走？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mud. They jump it, we slip.
dialogue.zh: 泥巴啊，狗跳得過去，人會滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no creek, and no pond.
dialogue.zh: 那就是沒有水溝也沒有水塘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the park loop, it is dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə pɑrk lup, ɪt ɪz draɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the bees near the field?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Late afternoon, they are calm.
dialogue.zh: 下午晚一點，牠們就安分了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now is late afternoon, right?
dialogue.zh: 現在就是下午晚了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, so walk fast, little man.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He knows the street by heart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By heart? He pulled you once.
dialogue.zh: 背起來？他有一次拉著你跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, toward the bakery door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bread smells make us all weak.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He got a crust that day.
dialogue.zh: 那天他得到一塊麵包皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A crust! That is a good story.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə krʌst! ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd ˈstɔri./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nina heard it, and told everyone.
dialogue.zh: 尼娜聽到了，講給所有人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Little Nina keeps this street posted.
dialogue.zh: 小尼娜是這條街的消息站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is good to be known.
dialogue.zh: 被人認識其實是件好事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time for bed, sir. Good night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is tired, look at him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time tomorrow, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same time. He will be at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm taɪm. hi wɪl bi æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 同一時間，他會在門口等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will wave from my porch.
dialogue.zh: 我會在陽台上跟你們揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, Sam. Good night, Milo.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday! You are up early.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam? Sorry to knock so soon.
dialogue.zh: 山姆？抱歉這麼早來敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never sorry, come in. What is up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ˈsɑri, kʌm ɪn. wʌt ɪz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 別這麼說，進來吧。怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My kitchen light hangs too low.
dialogue.zh: 我廚房的燈吊得太低了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too low, or it stopped working?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both. The bulb is dead, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then you need height, and a new bulb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju nid haɪt, ənd ə nu bʌlb./
dialogue.zh: 那就需要高度，還有一個新燈泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have a box of bulbs somewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə bɑks əv bʌlbz ˈsʌmwɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我有一整盒燈泡，放在哪兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somewhere in those boxes, hm.
dialogue.zh: 應該就在那些箱子裡，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All of them. My house is a maze.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl əv ðɛm. maɪ haʊs ɪz ə meɪz./
dialogue.zh: 全都還沒拆，我家像座迷宮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A maze with flowers, still nice.
dialogue.zh: 有花的迷宮，也還是不錯的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are kind. Do you have a ladder?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr kaɪnd. du ju hæv ə ˈlædər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tall one, in the garage.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tall is what I need today.
dialogue.zh: 高的正是我今天要用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is aluminum, light for you.
dialogue.zh: 它是鋁的，對妳來說很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light is perfect, my arms hurt.
dialogue.zh: 輕就太好了，我手臂還在痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait here, I will bring it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt hɪr, aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ɪt aʊt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, I will wait right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ, aɪ wɪl weɪt raɪt hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is. Hold this end, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz. hoʊld ðɪs ɛnd, pliz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? It is longer than my hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs? ɪt ɪz ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn maɪ hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？它比我玄關還長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six steps, good for a roof.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A roof? No, only my light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it on flat ground, see.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My tiles are not flat at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈtaɪlərz ɑr nɑt flæt ət ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我家的地磚一點都不平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then put a board under the feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pʊt ə bɔrd ˈʌndər ðə fit./
dialogue.zh: 那就在梯腳下墊一塊木板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A board! I have one by the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɔrd! aɪ hæv wʌn baɪ ðə sɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 一塊板！水槽邊剛好有一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Never stand on the top step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd. ˈnɛvər stænd ɑn ðə tɑp stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 很好。千萬別站最上面那階。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The very top? I would not.
dialogue.zh: 最上面那節嗎？我才不站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand on the second, hold the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd, hoʊld ðə reɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wear my shoes with grip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl wɛr maɪ ʃuz wɪð ɡrɪp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Do not climb in the wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd. du nɑt klaɪm ɪn ðə wɪnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No wind today, see? Not one leaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wɪnd təˈdeɪ, si? nɑt wʌn lif./
dialogue.zh: 今天沒風，你瞧？一片葉子都不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will hold the ladder, all right?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hoʊld ðə ˈlædər, ɔl raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我在下面扶著梯子，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? That makes me less scared.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那我就不那麼怕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take it slow, and face the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt sloʊ, ænd feɪs ðə wɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I am up. It is higher!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ æm ʌp. ɪt ɪz ˈhaɪər!/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe. Now, what do you see?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wire, and it looks burned.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Burned? Come down, right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am coming, I am coming!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not touch that, not yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What do we do first, Sam?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kill the power, the big box inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪl ðə ˈpaʊər, ðə bɪɡ bɑks ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 關電源，屋內那個大箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gray one next to my coats?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡreɪ wʌn nɛkst tu maɪ koʊts?/
dialogue.zh: 是外套旁邊那個灰色的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one. Flip the top switch off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn. flɪp ðə tɑp swɪtʃ ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 就那個，把最上面那顆關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off, done. Now it is dark in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf, dʌn. naʊ ɪt ɪz dɑrk ɪn hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, now that wire is dead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I call your cousin today?
dialogue.zh: 我今天該請你表哥來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, a burned wire is his job.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə bɜrnd waɪər ɪz hɪz dʒɑb./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call, and thank you both.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl, ənd θæŋk ju boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 我這就打電話，先謝謝你們兩位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ladder stays, you need the height.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlædər steɪz, ju nid ðə haɪt./
dialogue.zh: 梯子先放你那，你需要高度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But my shelves are also too high.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt maɪ ʃɛlvz ɑr ˈɔlsoʊ tu haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不過我的層架也太高了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How high? Let me look, first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The top shelf holds my winter plates.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɑp ʃɛlf hoʊldz maɪ ˈwɪntər pleɪts./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy things down low, light things up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi θɪŋz daʊn loʊ, laɪt θɪŋz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 重的放下層，輕的放上層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why did I never think of that?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dɪd aɪ ˈnɛvər θɪŋk əv ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼從沒想到這一招？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve years of that, believe me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I believe you! Coffee, inside?
dialogue.zh: 我完全相信！要進屋喝杯咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee sounds great, one minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milo, stay! Sorry, he is curious.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Curious dogs check every tool.
dialogue.zh: 好奇的狗會檢查每個工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He ate a screw once, I swear.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi eɪt ə skru wʌns, aɪ swɛr./
dialogue.zh: 他吃過一顆螺絲，我發誓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A screw! Did it come out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days later, yes, wow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dogs, hm. Now, your tool list.
dialogue.zh: 狗啊。來說說你的工具單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Screwdrivers, a wrench, and tape.
dialogue.zh: 螺絲起子、扳手，還有膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All three, plus a small hammer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! And a drill, do you have one?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! ənd ə drɪl, du ju hæv wʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two, both need new batteries.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will buy them, tell me which.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl baɪ ðɛm, tɛl mi wɪtʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small ones, at the store.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one on Third Street, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one, ask for the blue pack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn, æsk fər ðə blu pæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue pack, done. I write this down.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu pæk, dʌn. aɪ raɪt ðɪs daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My garage is open, most days.
dialogue.zh: 我的車庫大半時間都開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I go in by myself?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, knock, and take what you need.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, nɑk, ənd teɪk wʌt ju nid./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even if you are not home?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even then, the door is unlocked.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unlocked? That is a lot of trust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈlɑkt? ðæt ɪz ə lɑt əv trʌst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This street is still a safe one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs striːt ɪz stɪl ə seɪf wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這條街到現在都很安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring everything back clean.
dialogue.zh: 我會把東西都擦乾淨再還。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean, and put tape back on my roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin, ænd pʊt teɪp bæk ɑn maɪ roʊl./
dialogue.zh: 弄乾淨，膠帶也要捲回我這一捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your roll, sure. No problem.
dialogue.zh: 你的膠帶捲，當然沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday is tool day, we say.
dialogue.zh: 我們笑稱星期六是工具日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You named it already? Funny.
dialogue.zh: 你早就幫它命名了？好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more, the water under your sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr, ðə ˈwɔtər ˈʌndər jɔr sɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 還有一件，你水槽下面的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How did you know about that?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stain on your back step.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stain! I thought it was shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə steɪn! aɪ θɔt ɪt wʌz ʃeɪd./
dialogue.zh: 痕跡！我以為那只是陰影。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Find the valve, turn it right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small round one under the pipe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl raʊnd wʌn ˈʌndər ðə paɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 管子下面那個圓圓的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one, tight right, loose left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight right. I will remember that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the valve once a week.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once a week, no leak, no drama.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns ə wik, noʊ lik, noʊ ˈdrɑmə./
dialogue.zh: 一週一次，不漏水就安寧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tools back Monday, no rush.
dialogue.zh: 工具星期一還我就好，不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will return them with bread.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bread? Now you are the best neighbor.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɛd! naʊ ju ɑr ðə bɛst ˈneɪbər./
dialogue.zh: 麵包？那你就是最好的鄰居。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lemon bread, my shop's best trick.
dialogue.zh: 檸檬麵包，我店裡最拿手的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucy! Bins are out, your turn.
dialogue.zh: 露西！桶要拿出來了，換你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bins? I have only one bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trash day is Tuesday, one bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday! So it goes out tonight?
dialogue.zh: 星期二！那我今晚就要搬出去？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put it out by nine tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine is fine, I am always up.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɪz faɪn, aɪ æm ˈɔlweɪz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 九點可以，我那時還醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That truck is here at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six! That is before my shop.
dialogue.zh: 六點！那還在我開店之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sometimes five, if he is fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The driver? Does he wave?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old Ray waves at every house.
dialogue.zh: 老司機雷會對著每戶揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wave back, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the two bins by your wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ, ðə tu bɪnz baɪ jɔr wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 來說說你牆邊那兩個桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gray one and the green one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡreɪ wʌn ənd ði ɡrin wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 灰色那個和綠色那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green is recycling, gray is trash.
dialogue.zh: 綠桶是資源回收，灰桶是垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I knew one of them!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper, bottles, cans: green.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about the oily pizza box?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gray. Oil ruins the paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So clean boxes go to green.
dialogue.zh: 所以乾淨的紙盒進綠桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and rinse the jars first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse? Like a fast wash?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quick rinse, no soap needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy. And the plastic bags?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never in the green, they jam it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ɪn ðə ɡrin, ðeɪ dʒæm ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 綠桶千萬不要，它們會卡機台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jam the machine? Ah, I see.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So bags go in the gray.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or back to the store, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The store takes them, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have a mountain of bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone does. Keep them dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry, folded, in one bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good student! Now, the big rule.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, did I do something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close your lid, all the way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does not close flat, the lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz nɑt kloʊz flæt, ðə lɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too much stuff? Did you push it down?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌtʃ stʌf? dɪd ju pʊʃ ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 裝太多了嗎？妳有往下壓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No! I did not push anything.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cats open loose lids at night.
dialogue.zh: 貓晚上會撥開沒關的蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The orange cat! I knew it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Him, and two raccoons, maybe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Raccoons in my flower beds?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beds and bins. A strap will help.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛdz ænd bɪnz. ə stræp wɪl hɛlp./
dialogue.zh: 花圃和桶子都會翻，綁帶有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A strap? You have one spare?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two, take one, they are cheap.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You solve everything, Sam.
dialogue.zh: 什麼事你都搞得定，山姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only the easy things, friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about my huge old sofa?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, the couch. Big item day.
dialogue.zh: 啊，沙發。那要大件回收日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big item day? When is that?
dialogue.zh: 大件回收日？那是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once a year, in early October.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: October! It must live that long?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put it out the night before.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In my hall? It is enormous.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall, the stairs, the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do I move it alone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will not. The Patels help.
dialogue.zh: 妳不用一個人，帕泰爾家會幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The loud truck family?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That family. Strong kids, three.
dialogue.zh: 就是他們，三個孩子有力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring them cookies.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, parking. The hard part.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! My car sleeps in the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! maɪ kɑr slips ɪn ðə strit./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, but not on Thursday mornings.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但星期四早上不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday! Why, the sweeper?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sweeper, seven to nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I move it by seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move it before you leave home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My shop opens at seven!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then move it at six forty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six forty. I can do that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ticket is forty dollars flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty! No, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The white truck writes them fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The man in the white truck!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Him. Dana, the mail lady, warns us.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪm. ˈdeɪnə, ðə meɪl ˈleɪdi, wɔrnz ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 他。送信的黛娜會警告我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warns how, with a note?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A chalk mark on the pole.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chalk! I saw a mark yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is Thursday, friend. Move it.
dialogue.zh: 那就是星期四的記號，挪吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I moved it, I swear I did!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ muvd ɪt, aɪ swɛr aɪ dɪd!/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Also, no parking by that sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd. ˈɔlsoʊ, noʊ ˈpɑrkɪŋ baɪ ðæt saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 很好。還有那牌子邊不能停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red sign at the corner?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one marks the school bus stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn mɑrks ðə skul bʌs stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 那一塊是校車停靠的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The school bus! Kids cross there.
dialogue.zh: 校車！小孩在那裡過馬路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So keep it clear, both sides.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear. Can I park there at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪr. kæn aɪ pɑrk ðɛr æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 空著。那我晚上可以停那邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At night is fine, mostly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My sister visits Sunday, by car.
dialogue.zh: 我姊星期日會開車來看我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Park her in my driveway.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? Her car is very wide.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wide is fine, we have one van.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪd ɪz faɪn, wi hæv wʌn væn./
dialogue.zh: 寬沒關係，我們只有輛小貨車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A van! Do you still drive it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə væn! du ju stɪl draɪv ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kate drives, I only load it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Load what, all those tools?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaves, boxes, one old chair.
dialogue.zh: 落葉、紙箱，還有一張舊椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I should know about the van.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ ʃʊd noʊ əˈbaʊt ðə væn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask any time, day or night.
dialogue.zh: 隨時問我，白天晚上都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will post it on my fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl poʊst ɪt ɑn maɪ frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 我要把這些貼在冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the parking, Thursday, seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday, seven. Done, Sam.
dialogue.zh: 星期四，七點。寫好了，山姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday! The street grills tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 星期五！街上明天要烤肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grills? Like a party outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every year, in August, we grill.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have nothing for a party.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing? Bring yourself, that is all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? No dish to carry?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring a dish if you want.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I bring my fruit salad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fruit! Kate makes the potato one.
dialogue.zh: 水果！凱特做馬鈴薯沙拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two salads, that is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The Patels bring corn, always.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And Mr. Lee brings iced tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six big jars of his tea!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet, I hope. He likes sugar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too sweet, but cold is cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can bring lemons for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are thinking like a host.
dialogue.zh: 你已經在替主辦人想了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am scared, to be honest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scared of what? Twenty people?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know no one well yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know me, and Kate, and Nina.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ mi, ənd keɪt, ənd ˈninə./
dialogue.zh: 你認識我、凱特、還有尼娜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is three of twenty people.
dialogue.zh: 二十個人裡，我認得三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four more by the lemonade.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are kind, Sam, truly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear old clothes, smoke is bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old clothes I have, plenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closed shoes, the grill drops oil.
dialogue.zh: 穿包住的鞋，烤架會滴油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My sandals? Leave them home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come at four, we eat at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm æt fɔr, wi it æt sɪks./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four. Should I come early?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Early is best, we need hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can carry, I lifted boxes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. The road closes at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closes? With what, cones?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten orange cones, Mr. Ito's.
dialogue.zh: 十個橙色交通筒，伊藤的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His own cones! What a man.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our grill is big, two levels.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two levels of burgers?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Burgers, dogs, and corn on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have a veggie thing?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kate buys bean cakes, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bean cakes! I am not alone.
dialogue.zh: 豆餅！還好不是我一個人吃素。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two of us now, I am glad.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʌv ʌs naʊ, aɪ æm ɡlæd./
dialogue.zh: 那我們有兩個，我好高興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who cooks on the grill?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Me, and the Patels' oldest boy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is he good with fire?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charcoal, not fire, careful now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need lighter fluid?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have two cans, plenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I bring only my hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring ice, too, in a bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ice is heavy, I can lift.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if it rains on us?
dialogue.zh: 那要是我們頭上下雨呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain? The sky is so blue.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My garage holds all of us.
dialogue.zh: 真下雨，我車庫裝得下大家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A garage plan! That is wise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need nine chairs, maybe more.
dialogue.zh: 我們需要九張椅子，可能還要多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will bring my two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milo can come, we have space.
dialogue.zh: 米洛也可以來，我們有位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dog too? He will be calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔɡ tu? hi wɪl bi kɑm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bowl of water at the edge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, he drinks from puddles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday! Look, three fifty already.
dialogue.zh: 星期六！你看，才三點五十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am here early, like you said.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm hɪr ˈɜrli, laɪk ju sɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Early! Good. Take this plate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is warm! Smells so good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First burger goes to new friends.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To me? This is my first one!
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mi? ðɪs ɪz maɪ fɜrst wʌn!/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Street rule, ten years running now.
dialogue.zh: 街上的規矩，這樣過了十年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten years of first burgers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mrs. Park is showing her roses.
dialogue.zh: 朴太太在給人看她的薔薇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She cut me two today!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two roses! You are set, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In a cup on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nina is organizing the kids.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For what, a game?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A melon race, eat it fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With their faces? Kids are wild.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kate blows the whistle, ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, and they all bite!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Messy champions, all of them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, Milo got a piece!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A judge gave it to him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You were the judge, Sam!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guilty. He ate it cleanly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cleaner than the Patels' kids!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunset now, the lights are on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: String lights? On my street?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ito hangs them up every summer.
dialogue.zh: 伊藤每年夏天都會掛上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks like a small fair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You came, and you stayed late.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I forgot to be scared.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the leftovers, in foil.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Foil, and two corn, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next year you bring a dish.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And my name goes on the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ neɪm ɡoʊz ɑn ðə lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 那我的名字會上名單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ito will write it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I am on the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are, neighbor. Welcome home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Home. That word feels right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All done. My back says stop.
dialogue.zh: 都收好了。我的腰在喊停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You moved eight chairs tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six, and one broken one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it home, fix it there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe. The street is so quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone went inside, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A good day, Lucy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best day since I came.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Since you came? Two months, maybe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels like three years.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then this is your street too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. My street. That sounds nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before you go, my number.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your card! I still have it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You kept the paper card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In my wallet, with my keys.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then call it, let me hear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is ringing! Are you smiling?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. Now, your turn, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My number is one longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One longer? Say it slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven, two, double nine, four.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, my hands are old.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it, I will wait here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Lucy, with a star?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A star? Yes, I like that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved. Now I text you once.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My phone just buzzed! Perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The name says Lucy Flowers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I made that up, forgive me.
dialogue.zh: 那是我自己取的，原諒我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is good, clear, friendly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does mine say for you?
dialogue.zh: 我這邊你的名字寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam Next Door, with a house.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A house emoji? You are modern.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My grandson set that up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He sounds smart, your grandson.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven years old, and curious.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like Milo, but with words.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text me for tools, always.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And if the ladder falls?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First the ambulance, then a text.
dialogue.zh: 先叫救護車，再傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Funny. What else should I know?
dialogue.zh: 真幽默。我還有什麼要知道？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Packages. I bring yours inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You bring my packages inside?
dialogue.zh: 你會把我的包裹拿進屋？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only if the box is too small.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə bɑks ɪz tu smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 只有箱子太小、裝不下時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And mine sits high, you know.
dialogue.zh: 而且我的信箱很高，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will use your step stool.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red one? It is broken.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broken? Then I will fix it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said, only easy things!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small things. The big ones wait.
dialogue.zh: 小事可以，大的得再等等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair. What about the snow?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text me if my drive looks deep.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi ɪf maɪ draɪv lʊks dip./
dialogue.zh: 我車道的雪看著厚，就傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your drive? I will shovel it!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, no. Text me first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Before the snow, or after?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before. I bring the salt out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt and a big thermos, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A thermos! Hot tea at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the street, not only us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are planning winter already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask me next March about spring.
dialogue.zh: 明年三月，再問我春天的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, the street has a chat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A chat? Where, on a phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A group, Ito adds each house.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add me tonight, please, Sam.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, you are on the list now.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ju ɑr ɑn ðə lɪst naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What do people post there?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lost cats, sales, the trash day.
dialogue.zh: 走失的貓、特賣、還有垃圾日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And photos of Milo, I bet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nina posts dogs, mostly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She took one of him today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send it to me, then post.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sending now. Look at your phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There he is, mouth full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Melon thief, that is him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A gift from the party.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best photo of my new street.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee, Third Street, Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine? I am there at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine is early for me now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You old man, nine is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine! Bring Milo, he behaves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He sits under tables, mostly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday, then. Nine, my treat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine. I will be the early one.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn. aɪ wɪl bi ði ˈɜrli wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Then go sleep, young one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I slept nine hours once.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your gate light is still on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, I like the light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, Lucy, next door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night, Sam. Text me first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Sleep with both doors shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl. slip wɪð boʊθ dɔrz ʃʌt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shut and locked. Good night, all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milo says hi, from the step.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is waiting for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, and the day after.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A whole year, maybe, here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This fence is your front yard now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fɛns ɪz jɔr frʌnt jɑrd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這道圍欄現在是你的前院。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will knock, neighbor.
dialogue.zh: 那我就照規矩敲門，鄰居。
